name: fiscal-pilota-natale
description: Fiscal – Pilota Natale: prova d'acquisto regalo digitale

scripts.emulators: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('emulator-data',{recursive:true})" && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-fiscal-natale --import ./emulator-data --export-on-exit ./emulator-data
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix functions install
scripts.deploy: npm run web:build && npm run predeploy:check && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore,storage,functions
